summary: FiscalNote Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 21, 2026, disclosing that the NYSE staff filed a Form 25 to delist its Class A common stock and warrants, effective April 13, 2026. The securities now trade on OTCQB under symbols NOTE and NOTEW. To manage defaults from the delisting under subordinated convertible debt, the company entered into forbearance agreements with GPO FN Noteholder, LLC and YA II PN, Ltd, waiving defaults until May 21, 2026. The company intends to pursue listing on other exchanges. Watch for refinancing or capital raise risk as the forbearance deadline approaches.
